actions.description: Runs shell commands in the selected task runner.
actions.name: shell

properties.description: The lines handed to the interpreter, in order.
properties.label: Commands
properties.name: commands

properties.description: Selects the environment this task executes in.
properties.label: Task Runner
properties.name: taskRunner

properties.description: Where this task runs.
properties.label: Type
properties.name: type

properties.description: The container image the task runs in. Defaults to the image for the action's language. Only images an operator has allowed can be run.
properties.label: Image
properties.name: image

properties.description: When the image is pulled from its registry.
properties.label: Pull Policy
properties.name: pullPolicy

properties.description: Replaces the interpreter the source is handed to. Defaults to the interpreter for the action's language; the source file is appended either way.
properties.label: Entrypoint
properties.name: entrypoint

properties.description: The user the container runs as, as a name or a numeric uid[:gid].
properties.label: User
properties.name: user

properties.description: How many CPUs the container may use, as a decimal fraction of one CPU. Defaults to the operator's allowance, and cannot exceed the operator's maximum.
properties.label: CPU
properties.name: cpu

properties.description: How much memory the container may use, in bytes or with a b, k, m or g suffix. Defaults to the operator's allowance, and cannot exceed the operator's maximum.
properties.label: Memory
properties.name: memory

properties.description: The network the container is attached to.
properties.label: Network Mode
properties.name: networkMode

properties.description: Additional entries for the container's hosts file, each written as host:ip.
properties.label: Extra Hosts
properties.name: extraHosts

properties.description: The executable the source is handed to. Defaults to the interpreter for the action's language.
properties.label: Interpreter
properties.name: interpreter

properties.description: Environment variables the execution sees. The host's own environment is not inherited.
properties.label: Environment
properties.name: env

properties.description: Files written into the working directory before the execution, keyed by file name. A value may be inline text or a file entry.
properties.label: Input Files
properties.name: inputFiles

properties.description: Glob patterns matched against the output directory after the execution.
properties.label: Output Files
properties.name: outputFiles

properties.description: How long the execution may run before it is killed.
properties.label: Timeout (seconds)
properties.name: timeout

properties.description: Logs a warning when the execution writes to standard error.
properties.label: Warn On Standard Error
properties.name: warnOnStdErr
